changes: The network state (the record of what Terraform built for the network) adds a subnet. The app state adds four resources that need the subnet's id.
watch: Wave 1 (the first group of states to apply) builds the subnet, and only then does the subnet have an id. App's plan (Terraform's list of what it will change) in wave 2 contains that id, which no review saw, so wave 2 stops and waits for a person to approve it.
shows: Nothing lands without a person seeing it, even a value that didn't exist when the change was reviewed.
